itemList.description: Earth work excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the  selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work.In all kinds of soils Depth upto 1.5 m with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges and all other incidental charges etc., for successful completion of work as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

De-silting tank bed/Feeder Channel/Canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and disposing off the same by stacking/ formation of Embankment or as directed including cost of all machinery Labour and all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges and all other incidental charges etc., for successful completion of work as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Mix 1:4:8 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregateswith all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges and all other incidental charges etc., for successful completion of work as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.
